label: talk
server: local H = Osi.GetHostCharacter() for _, row in ipairs(GK.Stage.Scout{ kind = "characters", radius = 400, limit = 400 }) do if not row.dead and row.onStage and not row.enemy and #GK.Stage.Dialogs(row.uuid) > 0 then SceneSpeaker = row.uuid break end end if not SceneSpeaker then error("no character with a dialogue within 400 m") end GK.Stage.Bring(SceneSpeaker, H) return GK.Cheat.Talk(H, SceneSpeaker)

label: trade
server: local H = Osi.GetHostCharacter() local t = GK.Stage.Scout{ kind = "traders", limit = 5 } local trader for _, row in ipairs(t) do if not row.dead and not row.enemy then trader = row.uuid break end end if not trader then error("no trader in the level") end GK.Stage.Bring(trader, H) SceneTrader = trader return true
